## Work with us

At SRI, we’re always leaning toward the future — to the possibilities ahead — to bring to the world
the next generation of technologies, services, and ideas.

We’re blazing new trails every day in quantum, AI, human-machine collaboration, precision medicine,
education, sustainability, and much more.

**[Learn how you can make your mark — and build your own legacy][77]**.

## **Collaborate with **us

We take on the most difficult scientific challenges — and deliver. From our two locations in the
heart of Silicon Valley, plus our offices and labs throughout the U.S. and Tokyo, we collaborate
closely with government and commercial customers to meet their precise needs and specifications —
and to come up with solutions they may have never dreamed possible.

[**Learn more about how we might work together**.][78]

intersection of technology, business, and society. Reserve your spot at one of our upcoming events
and be a part of shaping the future with us. And find out how you can meet some of our researchers
at events throughout the U.S. and the world.

## Our Biometric Certification Programs

**CBSP **is a foundation level certification program for technology and security  professionals who
wish to gain a solid understanding of biometric technologies and its usage in real world
applications. This program is a starting point for individuals wanting to gain a deeper knowledge of
biometric technologies and applications.

[ Click here ][86]

**CBSE **designates knowledgeable technology professionals in the field of biometric security. This
program is designed for those who wish to gain a solid understanding of biometric technologies and
apply concepts and design principles to improve logical and physical access control in identity
management systems. Ideal candidates for this program include security architects, security
engineers, information assurance consultants, program managers and other individuals with experience
and expertise in information security related domains.

[ Click here ][87]

**CBSD **designates knowledgeable technology professionals in the field of biometric security. This
program is designed for those who wish to gain a solid understanding of biometric technologies and
apply concepts and COTS tools to improve logical and physical access control in identity management
systems. Ideal candidates for this program include security architects, Software & Application
Developers, Security Engineers, information assurance consultants, Program & Project Managers and
other individuals with experience and expertise in information security related domains. Prior
application and software programming experience is required.

[ Click here ][88]

The **Biometrics in AI** course explores the synergy between AI and biometric technologies, covering
cutting-edge advancements in facial recognition, fingerprint scanning, iris recognition, voice
authentication, and behavioral biometrics. Participants will gain hands-on knowledge of machine
learning algorithms, deep learning techniques, and neural networks that power modern biometric
systems.

What is browser fingerprinting?

Device fingerprinting or browser fingerprinting is the systematic collection of information about a
remote device, for identification purposes. Client-side scripting languages allow the development of
procedures to collect very rich fingerprints: browser and operating system type and version, screen
resolution, architecture type, lists of fonts, plugins, microphone, camera, etc.

yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

We envision a secure, seamless world where you are the key to everything. Our solutions – trusted by

## Security At Your Fingertips

Fingerprint biometrics remain the gold standard for fast, secure, and user-friendly identity
verification. With over a two decades of innovation, and almost 2 Billion sensors shipped, our
fingerprint technology delivers industry-leading accuracy, speed, and reliability across a wide
range of use cases.


From unlocking your phone to accessing critical systems in government and enterprise environments,
our technology provides a trusted layer of biometric security designed to fit seamlessly into your
product or infrastructure. We offer both modular sensors for integration as well as end-to-end
biometric systems in a package (SiP) for turnkey deployment.

[ Find Out More ][42]

## Access With A Glance

Iris Recognition technology delivers unmatched biometric precision for scenarios where security,
hygiene, and accuracy are paramount.

Built to identify individuals using the unique patterns in the human iris, our solutions are ideal
for high-security applications, such as national ID programs, border control, and secure access to
sensitive systems.

Leveraging proprietary algorithms, near-infrared imaging, and liveness detection, our iris
technology offers contactless authentication, even when users wear glasses, masks, or face coverings
— making it a reliable solution in both public health and high-threat environments.

[ Find Out More ][43]

## Face the Future of Authentication

Facial recognition is redefining how we authenticate identity in a digital-first, privacy-conscious
world. Our cutting-edge facial recognition technology enables contactless, secure, and user-friendly
authentication - whether you're verifying access to a building, logging into a mobile app, or
managing large-scale identity programs.

Built on advanced AI and machine learning, our solution supports 2D and 3D imaging, delivers instant
face matching, and includes built-in liveness detection to ensure the person in front of the camera
is real.

[ Find Out More ][44]

## Biometric security doesn’t end with recognition, it starts with how data is stored

Identity Nodes are a next-generation solution for biometric data protection, allowing organizations
to store, manage, and access biometric templates across distributed and decentralized storage nodes.

Unlike centralized systems, where a breach could compromise every user, Identity Nodes use template
fragmentation and distributed storage, ensuring that no single node holds the full biometric
identity. This architecture delivers unparalleled privacy compliance, resilience against attacks,
and data sovereignty - all while enabling seamless authentication workflows.

[ Find Out More ][45]

# The Free Enterprise Collaboration Platform

[ Download][13]
Latest version 2.1.11
[ Register Online][14]
Become a member of the Community
 

## What is it?

Foswiki is a platform, so you and your team members can collaborate and edit pages directly in the
web browser. For advanced collaboration, Foswiki lets you enter macros to automate pages and build
entire applications from within your browser. Find out [what makes Foswiki the ideal collaboration
tool][15] for your project, team or business.

## Benefits
* World class **[text editor built in][16]**, so that you get what you see.
* Create **[dynamic pages][17]**: status boards, to-do lists, inventory systems, employee handbooks,
  bug trackers and much more
* **Customize the layout** of the site, or per page, user or group
* Over **[200 polished extensions][18] all actively maintained,** to expand the out of the box
  functions
* **[Compatible with TWiki][19]**, including a **[seamless migration path][20]**
* **[Free, friendly, and effective community-based support][21]** by a community dedicated to
  democracy

## Where to go from here?

Foswiki lets you organize your website into separate webs. The [Extensions Web][41] lets you add new
capabilities to your site. Go to the [Support Web][42] to browse repository of support questions or
to find out about getting support.

[Learn about all webs on this site, and how to keep up to date.][43]

### Talk to us

[Chat in realtime on IRC][44], participate on our [mailing lists][45], [report a sensitive security
issue][46] or just cheer us up with [a short mail][47].

Find a [Foswiki consultant][48] to create or customize your Foswiki site.

### Meet the Community

Learn about the [Foswiki Community][49]. The [Foswiki Association][50] is a non-profit foundation,
tasked with caring for the interests of the Foswiki project. Find out who are the [people building
Foswiki][51]. [Register for an account][52], and [play in the Sandbox][53].

### Donate

Foswiki is in need of labour and money. If you want to donate the latter, please use the Donate
button.

Get information on [how to donate][54].

## Where to go from here?

Foswiki lets you organize your website into separate webs. The [Extensions Web][41] lets you add new
capabilities to your site. Go to the [Support Web][42] to browse repository of support questions or
to find out about getting support.

[Learn about all webs on this site, and how to keep up to date.][43]

### Talk to us

[Chat in realtime on IRC][44], participate on our [mailing lists][45], [report a sensitive security
issue][46] or just cheer us up with [a short mail][47].

Find a [Foswiki consultant][48] to create or customize your Foswiki site.

### Meet the Community

Learn about the [Foswiki Community][49]. The [Foswiki Association][50] is a non-profit foundation,
tasked with caring for the interests of the Foswiki project. Find out who are the [people building
Foswiki][51]. [Register for an account][52], and [play in the Sandbox][53].

### Donate

Foswiki is in need of labour and money. If you want to donate the latter, please use the Donate
button.

Get information on [how to donate][54].

Manuscripts submitted to The International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology should:
* contribute to existing research work;
* be original, and not have been published anywhere;
* present data clearly and concisely;
* mention engineering data & applications;

All accepted papers in IJERT will be published under a Creative Commons Licence and will be freely
available on the IJERT Digital Library.

IJERT has the team of **more than **[2000 prominent reviewers][44]** and renowned [editorial board
members][45]** from well-known academic institutions around the globe. The primary goal of the
reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the
case in the future and IJERT helps them to achieve their goal.

# OWASP
# Modsecurity Project

[Rules protecting a safe]

## Open Source Web Application Firewall

[ModSecurity][14] is an open source, cross-platform web application firewall (WAF) module. Known as
the “Swiss Army Knife” of WAFs, it enables web application defenders to gain visibility into HTTP(S)
traffic and provides a power rules language and API to implement advanced protections.

[Get latest v2: 2.9.12][15] [Get latest v3: 3.0.14][16]

## The most widespread open source WAF

Used by businesses, government organizations, internet service providers, and commercial WAF vendors
alike on millions of domains all over the world. The engine, coupled with OWASP CRS - the dominant
WAF rule set, undeniably raises the level of protection against HTTP attacks to a higher level.

[Become a part of it!][17]

## ModSecurity under OWASP's custodianship

OWASP® Foundation, the leading open community dedicated to application security, is already
responsible for the Core Rule Set, the dominant WAF rule set on the market. By joining the
ModSecurity WAF to their repertoire, OWASP can now steer ModSecurity’s development with a holistic
view, fostering even tighter integration between the core rule set and the underlying framework.
[Rules protecting a safe]

### Getting Started

## Usage scenarios
* Real-time application security monitoring and access control
* Full HTTP traffic logging
* Continuous passive security assessment
* Web application hardening

* Flexibility
* Passiveness
* Predictability
* Quality over quantity

the “Swiss Army Knife” of WAFs, it enables web application defenders to gain visibility into HTTP(S)
traffic and provides a power rules language and API to implement advanced protections.

[Get latest v2: 2.9.12][15] [Get latest v3: 3.0.14][16]

## The most widespread open source WAF

Used by businesses, government organizations, internet service providers, and commercial WAF vendors
alike on millions of domains all over the world. The engine, coupled with OWASP CRS - the dominant
WAF rule set, undeniably raises the level of protection against HTTP attacks to a higher level.

[Become a part of it!][17]

## ModSecurity under OWASP's custodianship

OWASP® Foundation, the leading open community dedicated to application security, is already
responsible for the Core Rule Set, the dominant WAF rule set on the market. By joining the
ModSecurity WAF to their repertoire, OWASP can now steer ModSecurity’s development with a holistic
view, fostering even tighter integration between the core rule set and the underlying framework.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

## NAIA

NAIA Global Inc. traces its origins to the North American Importers Association (NAIA), an
organization founded in Washington, D.C. in 1987. With a longstanding history and an extensive
global network, NAIA has supported international trade by providing vital resources in sourcing,
procurement, and business development to over 137,000 importer members across five continents.

Building on this foundation, NAIA Global Inc. was established as a professional and independent
entity in Taiwan. Evolving from NAIA’s original Asia-Pacific operations, the company is committed to
bridging the strength of Asian manufacturing with the demands of global markets. Our mission is to
foster meaningful, long-term partnerships between Asian suppliers and international buyers.

With a seasoned consulting team and decades of practical experience, NAIA Global Inc. offers
tailored solutions across more than 300 industries, including hardware, machinery, plastics,
electronics, food, and building materials.

NAIA Global delivers far more than a traditional matchmaking platform—it is a strategic partner that
empowers Asian manufacturers to expand their global reach and realize their full potential on the
international stage. Through our international reach and local expertise, we aim to make every
collaboration a stepping stone toward lasting value.

## Strategic Partner

Member Importer Benefits
* Auto-matching with compatible, pre-qualified member suppliers.
* Assist in further sourcing if none is available.
* Co-ordinate & liaise in sampling & execution of orders.
* Act as mediator during unavoidable commercial disputes.
* Credit verification of member suppliers.
* Travel arrangement.

* Assist in certificate application in USA.****

We envision a secure, seamless world where you are the key to everything. Our solutions – trusted by

secure, convenient authentications daily across devices, cards, and digital platforms.

## Security At Your Fingertips

Fingerprint biometrics remain the gold standard for fast, secure, and user-friendly identity
verification. With over a two decades of innovation, and almost 2 Billion sensors shipped, our
fingerprint technology delivers industry-leading accuracy, speed, and reliability across a wide
range of use cases.


From unlocking your phone to accessing critical systems in government and enterprise environments,
our technology provides a trusted layer of biometric security designed to fit seamlessly into your
product or infrastructure. We offer both modular sensors for integration as well as end-to-end
biometric systems in a package (SiP) for turnkey deployment.

[ Find Out More ][42]

## Access With A Glance

Iris Recognition technology delivers unmatched biometric precision for scenarios where security,
hygiene, and accuracy are paramount.

Built to identify individuals using the unique patterns in the human iris, our solutions are ideal
for high-security applications, such as national ID programs, border control, and secure access to
sensitive systems.

Leveraging proprietary algorithms, near-infrared imaging, and liveness detection, our iris
technology offers contactless authentication, even when users wear glasses, masks, or face coverings
— making it a reliable solution in both public health and high-threat environments.

[ Find Out More ][43]

## Face the Future of Authentication

Facial recognition is redefining how we authenticate identity in a digital-first, privacy-conscious
world. Our cutting-edge facial recognition technology enables contactless, secure, and user-friendly
authentication - whether you're verifying access to a building, logging into a mobile app, or
managing large-scale identity programs.

Built on advanced AI and machine learning, our solution supports 2D and 3D imaging, delivers instant
face matching, and includes built-in liveness detection to ensure the person in front of the camera
is real.

[ Find Out More ][44]

## Biometric security doesn’t end with recognition, it starts with how data is stored

Identity Nodes are a next-generation solution for biometric data protection, allowing organizations
to store, manage, and access biometric templates across distributed and decentralized storage nodes.

Unlike centralized systems, where a breach could compromise every user, Identity Nodes use template
fragmentation and distributed storage, ensuring that no single node holds the full biometric
identity. This architecture delivers unparalleled privacy compliance, resilience against attacks,
and data sovereignty - all while enabling seamless authentication workflows.

[ Find Out More ][45]

#### Passwords Are Everywhere

Healthcare clinicians lose 30–60 minutes per day logging in/out.

Up to 50% of all helpdesk tickets are for password resets.

# The Free Enterprise Collaboration Platform

[ Download][13]
Latest version 2.1.11
[ Register Online][14]
Become a member of the Community
 

## What is it?

Foswiki is a platform, so you and your team members can collaborate and edit pages directly in the
web browser. For advanced collaboration, Foswiki lets you enter macros to automate pages and build
entire applications from within your browser. Find out [what makes Foswiki the ideal collaboration
tool][15] for your project, team or business.

## Benefits
* World class **[text editor built in][16]**, so that you get what you see.
* Create **[dynamic pages][17]**: status boards, to-do lists, inventory systems, employee handbooks,
  bug trackers and much more
* **Customize the layout** of the site, or per page, user or group
* Over **[200 polished extensions][18] all actively maintained,** to expand the out of the box
  functions
* **[Compatible with TWiki][19]**, including a **[seamless migration path][20]**
* **[Free, friendly, and effective community-based support][21]** by a community dedicated to
  democracy

**International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology** is a **peer-reviewed, open access**
and **multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science journal** that publishes original
research & review articles of all major branches of Engineering, Science and Technology. We have
adopted a fully open access publishing model which allows open global access to its published
content so anyone can download & read articles round the clock totally free of cost. IJERT is
included in many leading abstracting and indexing open access databases like Google Scholar &
ResearchGate. For a complete list, [view here.][42]

IJERT does not charge readers or their institutions for access to more than 25000 published
articles. The open access supports the rights of users to read, download, copy, distribute, print,
search, or link to the full texts of these articles provided they are properly acknowledged and
cited.

IJERT publishes **12 issues per year** not including special conference issues.

exposure.

citations.

All articles are evaluated using criteria including the excellence, novelty and significance of the
research or ideas.

research and review articles , ensuring we publish scientifically sound research across a broad
spectrum of engineering areas.

**International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology** is a **peer-reviewed, open access**
and **multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science journal** that publishes original
research & review articles of all major branches of Engineering, Science and Technology. We have
adopted a fully open access publishing model which allows open global access to its published
content so anyone can download & read articles round the clock totally free of cost. IJERT is
included in many leading abstracting and indexing open access databases like Google Scholar &
ResearchGate. For a complete list, [view here.][42]

IJERT does not charge readers or their institutions for access to more than 25000 published
articles. The open access supports the rights of users to read, download, copy, distribute, print,
search, or link to the full texts of these articles provided they are properly acknowledged and
cited.

IJERT publishes **12 issues per year** not including special conference issues.

### Why Publish in IJERT ?

### Broad Scope

Impact of your work will have on researchers outside your field and the potential for greater
exposure.

### Indexed

Increase visibility, availability, and readership of your work on internet which attracts good
citations.

### Peer-Reviewed

All articles are evaluated using criteria including the excellence, novelty and significance of the
research or ideas.

In the area of research and innovation, each day we passionately push the limits of science and
engineering by regularly publishing state-of-art peer reviewed research content in **IJERT having**
**more than 2 million articles ****downloads** per year.

IJER 100% emphasis on high quality research content, thorough peer-review which exists on all our
research and review articles , ensuring we publish scientifically sound research across a broad
spectrum of engineering areas.

Manuscripts submitted to The International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology should:
* contribute to existing research work;
* be original, and not have been published anywhere;
* present data clearly and concisely;
* mention engineering data & applications;

All accepted papers in IJERT will be published under a Creative Commons Licence and will be freely
available on the IJERT Digital Library.

IJERT has the team of **more than **[2000 prominent reviewers][44]** and renowned [editorial board
members][45]** from well-known academic institutions around the globe. The primary goal of the
reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the
case in the future and IJERT helps them to achieve their goal.

## Lite Tools - Free Online Tools for PDF, Images, Calculators and More

**Lite Tools** is a free online tools hub built for everyday digital work. You can compress images,
resize photos, merge PDF files, convert PDF pages, calculate percentages, create QR codes, use
student tools and complete common tasks directly in your browser.

The goal is simple: give users quick, lightweight and easy-to-use tools without downloads,
registration or complicated software. Whether you are a student, creator, office worker, business
owner or casual user, Lite Tools helps you finish small but important tasks faster.

## Popular Free Online Tools
* **Image Tools:** compress images, crop photos, resize images, add watermark and convert images to
  PDF.
* **PDF Tools:** merge PDF, split PDF, compress PDF, remove PDF pages and convert PDF to image.
* **Calculators:** percentage calculator, age calculator, currency converter, EMI calculator and
  finance calculators.
* **YouTube Tools:** thumbnail downloader, tag extractor, description extractor and embed code
  generator.
* **Student Tools:** online notepad, to-do list, typing speed test, attendance calculator and exam
  percentage calculator.
* **Utility Tools:** QR code scanner, UPI QR code generator, resume builder and simple browser-based

# OWASP
# Modsecurity Project

[Rules protecting a safe]

## Open Source Web Application Firewall

[ModSecurity][14] is an open source, cross-platform web application firewall (WAF) module. Known as
the “Swiss Army Knife” of WAFs, it enables web application defenders to gain visibility into HTTP(S)
traffic and provides a power rules language and API to implement advanced protections.

[Get latest v2: 2.9.12][15] [Get latest v3: 3.0.14][16]

## The most widespread open source WAF

Used by businesses, government organizations, internet service providers, and commercial WAF vendors
alike on millions of domains all over the world. The engine, coupled with OWASP CRS - the dominant
WAF rule set, undeniably raises the level of protection against HTTP attacks to a higher level.

[Become a part of it!][17]

## ModSecurity under OWASP's custodianship

OWASP® Foundation, the leading open community dedicated to application security, is already
responsible for the Core Rule Set, the dominant WAF rule set on the market. By joining the
ModSecurity WAF to their repertoire, OWASP can now steer ModSecurity’s development with a holistic
view, fostering even tighter integration between the core rule set and the underlying framework.
[Rules protecting a safe]

### Getting Started

## Usage scenarios
* Real-time application security monitoring and access control
* Full HTTP traffic logging
* Continuous passive security assessment
* Web application hardening

[Download][18]

## Principles
* Flexibility
* Passiveness
* Predictability
* Quality over quantity

[Getting Started][19]

# About us

Since company establishment in 1988, PERCo major activity has been the development and serial
production of security systems and equipment. Now the high quality of PERCo products is recognised
throughout the industry in 96 countries worldwide.

PERCo quality management system is certified in accordance with the ISO 9001:2015 international
standard.

The warranty period for all PERCo products is 5 years from the date of sale. Thanks to the
state-of-the-art production facilities and the use of innovative technologies, PERCo designs,
manufactures and successfully markets products that meet international standards of the security
industry.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

## NAIA

NAIA Global Inc. traces its origins to the North American Importers Association (NAIA), an
organization founded in Washington, D.C. in 1987. With a longstanding history and an extensive
global network, NAIA has supported international trade by providing vital resources in sourcing,
procurement, and business development to over 137,000 importer members across five continents.

Building on this foundation, NAIA Global Inc. was established as a professional and independent
entity in Taiwan. Evolving from NAIA’s original Asia-Pacific operations, the company is committed to
bridging the strength of Asian manufacturing with the demands of global markets. Our mission is to
foster meaningful, long-term partnerships between Asian suppliers and international buyers.

With a seasoned consulting team and decades of practical experience, NAIA Global Inc. offers
tailored solutions across more than 300 industries, including hardware, machinery, plastics,
electronics, food, and building materials.

NAIA Global delivers far more than a traditional matchmaking platform—it is a strategic partner that
empowers Asian manufacturers to expand their global reach and realize their full potential on the
international stage. Through our international reach and local expertise, we aim to make every
collaboration a stepping stone toward lasting value.

## Strategic Partner

Member Importer Benefits
* Auto-matching with compatible, pre-qualified member suppliers.
* Assist in further sourcing if none is available.
* Co-ordinate & liaise in sampling & execution of orders.
* Act as mediator during unavoidable commercial disputes.
* Credit verification of member suppliers.
* Travel arrangement.
